scoring_end: last original raw observation time minus 3 seconds
common_scoring_axis: original raw times >=2-EPS and <=scoring_end+EPS, using unchanged frozen evaluation EPS
earliest_support_rule: first common scoring t with contact-2-EPS <= t <= contact+EPS, by searchsorted left on contact-2-EPS
upper_lead_definition: contact-earliest_support_time; no common support frame remains an explicit unsupported category, never a zero-imputed lead
actual_pointwise_checks: each finite valid confirmation is exactly a stored common scoring timestamp
actual valid cannot precede earliest supported common frame
actual covered indices at each threshold are a subset of ceiling-covered indices, not just lower net counts
denominator: all eligible RIGHT points, including actual window misses
derivation_arrays: earliest common-frame indices, support availability and upper leads regenerable from frozen labels and raw time axis, recorded by dtype/shape/SHA256; these are not new prediction outputs
